newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-VICTORY IN NICE MARRED BY LOOTING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VICTORY IN NICE MARRED BY LOOTING.

text.p: Soccer fans celebrating victory by Nice in the French soccer cup final smashed shop windows and looted a bar and a sporting goods store in the city centre, police said on Sunday.
Thousands of jubilant Nice supporters poured into the streets of the Riviera capital late on Saturday after the team took the trophy for the third time in a 4-3 victory over Guingamp.
A police officer trying to keep order was slightly injured during the celebrations, which continued into the early hours of Sunday, police said.
Nice previously won the cup in 1952 and 1954 and was a losing finalist in 1978.
